description: Before settling a deal between two agents (an escrow or delivery-vs-payment swap, for example on Bull), check it against the market: one side delivers `amount` of `token`, the other pays `pay` of `payToken` (default USDG on Robinhood Chain). Both sides are priced with Stoa's live router for the same size, fee and price impact included, and the delivered token gets Stoa's safety check. Or pass bullDeal with a Bull deal ID and Stoa reads the terms itself. Returns verdict fair | buyer_overpays | seller_underpaid | partial | thin_market, each side's edge in %, and the safety verdict. Read-only.

amount.description: Amount of token delivered, in its smallest unit (wei).

bullDeal.description: A Bull (bull.family) deal ID on Robinhood Chain: Stoa reads its terms from Bull's API and checks them. Use this instead of token, amount and pay.

pay.description: Amount paid, in payToken's smallest unit (USDG has 6 decimals).

payToken.description: Token paid (default the chain's stablecoin, USDG on Robinhood Chain): a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

token.description: Token being delivered: a token address, or "native" for the gas token (ETH on Robinhood Chain, HYPE on Elysium).

name: fair_price
title: Fair-price check for an OTC or escrow deal
